notes: A waltz-like tide in 3/4: up by step from the home note to the fifth, held across the bar, then down past the start to the leading note. Plain and singable; the held note is the high water. Spring: D major, bright piano; the bed comes in for the answer, a flute echoes the held note, harp touches the cadences.
